test_failure.message: Failed to determine hittability of "Resize column" Button: Activation point invalid and no suggested hit points based on element frame
test_failure.explanation: The diagnostic enumerated unrelated buttons and asked XCTest to hit-test an offscreen resize handle before it reached the Tools assertion. The Inbox screenshot and full accessibility hierarchy were already saved; navigation.json was not produced.

inference: The 874-point shell begins after WebKit’s 62-point top inset, while its visible safe content is 778 points high. Its normal-flow 52-point navigation is consequently below the application frame. Source inspection identifies 100vh with automatic viewport insetting; this is an offscreen geometry defect, not evidence of an absent mount or OCR capability.
qualification_limits: No successful Tools, OCR, or Add documents navigation occurred.
No corrected application binary was tested in this run.
The before-test installed bundle identity was verified; the harness failed before its after-test hash.
The raw accessibility tree establishes frames; the Tools hittability query was not reached.
No OCR recognition, external provider, camera, or physical-device qualification.
